'''Julien Rivière''' (printed by Decipher as "Juliën Riviëre", and as "Julien Riviere" on DeckTech) is a Star Wars CCG player from France (DeckTech handle '''Dark Padawan'''). He won the [[2000 French National Championship]] and Saturday's constructed event at the [[2001 Brugge Belgian Open]], published constructed lists on DeckTech and [[Decipher deck designs|Decipher Deck Designs]], and wrote tournament reports for DeckTech.
